name: mobile-web-debugging
description: Guide Codex to expose local web apps to phones with VS Code Port Forwarding and devtunnels.ms.

interface.shortDescription: Open local web apps on phones with VS Code dev tunnels.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight optional plugin that helps Codex use VS Code Port Forwarding / devtunnels.ms to expose a local web server as an HTTPS URL for mobile Safari or Chrome testing, with clear authorization and Public/Private visibility safeguards.
defaultPrompt: Forward my local web app to my phone.
Use VS Code dev tunnels for port 3000.
